name: Ocar
description: Intercity cab booking for Odisha — reliable, efficient, local.
narrative: Ocar's system is built around reliability made visible. Indigo punctuates; it does not flood. Shadows carry the brand color. Orange is operational, never decorative. One font. Clean surfaces. The primary action on any screen is unmissable.

primary.role: Brand anchor — CTAs, active states, logomark gradient, focus rings

accent-violet.role: Gradient partner to primary — logomark arc endpoint and splash glow only
accent-violet.boundary: Not used as a standalone UI color

accent-orange.role: Operational — driver go-online CTA, admin alerts. Never on the user booking flow.
accent-orange.boundary: Driver app and admin portal only

success.role: Completed rides, verified status, positive earnings

ink-900.role: Primary text — headlines, body, labels, data
ink-900.note: Cool undertone (#0F172A) matches indigo-tinted surface family

ink-600.role: Secondary text — supporting labels, metadata, form hints. Passes 4.5:1 on white.

ink-400.role: Muted — placeholders, disabled labels, nav at rest. Verify contrast on tinted backgrounds.

splash-bg.role: Splash screen only — deep indigo-dark that lets the gradient logomark glow
splash-bg.boundary: Not used as a UI surface in any app screen

card.usage: Default card on user app. Barely perceptible; separates card from indigo-tinted bg.

card-admin.usage: Admin portal cards and panels. Two-layer: structural + brand ambient.

button-primary.usage: Indigo CTA in user app. The shadow is the affordance signal — it marks the primary action.

button-primary-hover.usage: Hover state for indigo CTA. Shadow deepens; button does not move.

button-go-online.usage: Driver go-online CTA. Orange-tinted shadow matches button accent.

sheet.usage: Bottom sheets. Directional upward to separate from scrollable content behind.

float.usage: Floating chips, active search bar, trip-type selector.

glow.usage: Focus rings and hover states on primary elements in the admin portal (desktop).

rules: 150–250ms for all state transitions. No orchestrated page-load sequences.
Motion conveys state — feedback, reveal, loading. Never decoration.
prefers-reduced-motion: every animation has a fallback (instant or crossfade).
Splash is the single exception to the 250ms ceiling — it is a brand moment, not a state change.

user-app.layout: Single column, centered with translateZ(0) containment
user-app.note: User and driver apps are mobile-only. The 430px container is the entire canvas.

divergences.issue: Loads Poppins for some display text
Primary color is #2563EB (blue) in some components, not #4F46E5 (indigo)
divergences.resolution: Audit and replace at next refactor pass
Replace with background tint or remove
